def transform(grid):
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        # Complete a partial left-to-right bar by replacing its background tail.
        k = 0
        while k < len(row) and row[k] != bg:
            k += 1
        if 0 < k < len(row) and all(v == bg for v in row[k:]):
            out[r][k:] = [1] * (len(row) - k)
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
